name: Read active critical Nizlo alerts with HTTP Request

parameters.content:
## Before you run

Use an authorized test workspace and a Nizlo personal access token limited to `alerts.view`. On the HTTP Request node, add a Header Auth credential with name `Authorization` and value `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`. Save the credential in n8n.

This manual workflow requests only page 1, with up to 50 alerts reported as active and critical. Inspect `items` and `total` in the node output. An empty list is valid.

[Setup and expected output](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/n8n-rmm-integration.html?utm_source=n8n_workflow&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=n8n_critical_alerts#built-in-http-template)
